title: Canada’s Proposed Oil Pipeline Offers Carney Relief From Domestic and Global Turmoil
summary_full: The new pipeline from Alberta’s oil sands to the Pacific Coast may lower separatist tensions in that province while also loosening energy ties with the U.S.
